description: This file defines the MessageSender interface for publishing messages to Hono, including methods for sending messages, checking connection status, and closing the sender.

classes.name: MessageSender
classes.description: Interface for sending messages to Hono, extending CreditBasedSender, with methods for message transmission and connection management.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the name of the endpoint this sender sends messages to.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the AMQP link with the Hono server.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the sender is (locally) open.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an AMQP message asynchronously, returning a Future indicating success or failure.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Default method to send a message with tracing context, delegating to the primary send method.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the transfer outcome, returning a Future.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Default method to send a message with tracing context, delegating to the primary method.
